layouts.name: Airfield perimeter 2020
layouts.description: Complete historical perimeter road retains the rounded Western end, Northern straight, Eastern outer straight and Southern inward bend. The developer identifies this peri-track as a five-kilometre loop. Exact pinned 2020 source nodes exclude the Top Gear inner loops and business-park access roads.

layouts.name: Main runway 2020
layouts.description: Historical paved main runway centerline retains its two independently mapped endpoints. The operator identifies asphalt runway 07/25. These are physical runway ends, not verified event timing gates or takeoff-distance endpoints. No connection to the surrounding perimeter is invented.
